title: Vasco da Gama reaches India
summary: A Portuguese fleet rounds Africa and arrives at Calicut, opening a sea route from Europe to the Indian Ocean.
body: The Indian Ocean already had a sophisticated trade world. Portuguese guns and cartaz licences forced a new, violent European presence into it. Editorial draft for this timeline, not a substitute for specialist literature.

sources.name: Subrahmanyam, The Career and Legend of Vasco da Gama
